verdict.rationale: Alloy markets "agentic automation" for KYC/AML workflows, so whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence documents connecting MCP servers or using their tools. The pack covers only the Events API, webhooks, workflows, health signals and SSO, none of which is MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
